story: At 7:17 on this sunny Monday morning in Sumter Oaks, Gary is at his workbench at home, soldering and bench-testing the speaker and light wiring for his golf cart with steady determination. Donna is at her kitchen table with the club calendar, penciling in a pickleball practice slot for herself and Gary while sketching out plans for the Halloween cart parade. Across the way, Hal is keeping a watchful eye on Magnolia Loop through his binoculars, counting ornaments and noting which carts might be getting modified for the season. Rosa, content and busy as always, is checking her per-diem shifts for the week and penciling in time to help with Halloween parade planning.
events: Gary (gary workbench): Solder and bench-test the speaker and light wiring for the cart
Donna (donna club calendar): Check this week's club schedule and pencil in a pickleball practice slot for Gary and me, plus Halloween cart planning
Hal (hal binoculars): Scan Magnolia Loop for Halloween decorations, ornament counts, and cart modifications
Rosa (rosa shift schedule): Check my per-diem shifts for the week and pencil in time for Halloween parade planning

gary.thought_process: It's early Monday morning and I'm home. The weird part is my memories say I went to Magnolia Loop at tick 205 and checked the bulletin board at 206, but now I'm at my house with my workbench and cart around me. Whatever the case, I filed the Architectural Review application at tick 156 and I've been careful to keep the cart in the garage with no visible mods until the board signs off (L-01). The wiring sketch is drawn and bench-tested, so the sketch is done. Best use of this hour is to keep working on the sound system and lights on the workbench, which is all inside the garage and not visible from the street, so it's perfectly legal. Halloween parade is Saturday, so time matters. Staying busy also keeps the quiet house from feeling too quiet.

parameters.content: Solder and bench-test the speaker and light wiring for the cart

donna.thought_process: It's a fresh Monday morning and I'm home alone. Last night at Rosa's went beautifully, and I've got the ladder match with Gary coming up plus the Halloween parade to organize. The club calendar is right here, so I should check what's on the books this week, lock in practice time for Gary within the two-hour court limit, and pencil in the Halloween cart planning before anyone else grabs the slots.

parameters.content: Check this week's club schedule and pencil in a pickleball practice slot for Gary and me, plus Halloween cart planning

hal.thought_process: Quiet Monday morning, nobody in sight. My memories say Gary and Donna have been cooperating, flamingos are holding at three, and the neighborhood has been looking out for each other. Still, a watchdog does his rounds. The binoculars are right here on the porch. A sergeant checks the perimeter at dawn, and Halloween decorations are going up all week, so I'll want to know where the Loop stands before anyone gets creative.

parameters.content: Scan Magnolia Loop for Halloween decorations, ornament counts, and cart modifications

rosa.thought_process: The dinner went well last night and everyone's on board for the Halloween cart parade, but it's a new morning and I'm home alone. The shift schedule is sitting right there, and I've been picking up per-diem shifts while trying to host and organize. I should check it so I don't overcommit and can protect time for the parade planning this week.

parameters.content: Check my per-diem shifts for the week and pencil in time for Halloween parade planning

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
